meta.name: ab-testing
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment, or build a growth experimentation program. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "should I test this," "which version is better," "test two versions," "statistical significance," "how long should I run this test," "growth experiments," "experiment velocity," "experiment backlog," "ICE score," "experimentation program," or "experiment playbook." Use this whenever someone is comparing two approaches and wants to measure which performs better, or when they want to build a systematic experimentation practice. For tracking implementation, see analytics. For page-level conversion optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行科学的A/B实验，用数据决策版本优劣
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常纠结两个版本哪个更好，想用数据说话。
copy.tagline_en: Design and run A/B tests to choose better versions with data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often decide between versions and want data-driven answers.

howto.what: Claude 会协助你设计 A/B 测试：理清业务背景、写假设、定指标、算样本量、设计变体，并分析结果是否显著。它也能帮你建立增长实验机制，如用 ICE 评分排优先级、维护实验记录。
howto.when: 当用户提到“A/B test”、“experiment”等关键词，或想计划/设计/实施 A/B 测试，或想建立增长实验项目，或想比较两个版本哪个更好时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 A/B 测试，目标是提高注册转化率。
say.note: Claude 会先了解背景再给出测试方案。

say.text: 我的页面基线转化率是 5%，每天流量 1000，样本量要多少？
say.note: Claude 会按统计原理估算样本量。

say.text: 根据这份实验结果，告诉我是否显著以及下一步该怎么做。
say.note: Claude 会检查显著性并给出解读。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through A/B test design (context, hypothesis, metrics, sample size, variants) and result analysis. It also helps build a growth experimentation program (ICE scoring, playbooks).
howto.when_en: When the user mentions keywords like "A/B test" or "experiment," or wants to plan/design/run an A/B test, build a growth experimentation program, or compare two versions to see which is better.

say_en.text: Help me design an A/B test to increase sign-up conversion.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for missing context before planning.

say_en.text: My baseline conversion is 5% with 1k daily visits. What sample size do I need?
say_en.note: Claude will estimate the required sample size.

say_en.text: Here are the results. Tell me if it's significant and what to do next.
say_en.note: Claude will check significance and interpret results.
